name: wiredwhips
description: Read-only catalog of OEM and aftermarket e-bike and electric dirt bike parts from Wired Whips, with fitment checks.

interface.longDescription:
WiredWhips is a read-only catalog of OEM and aftermarket e-bike and electric dirt bike parts from brands including Sur-Ron, Talaria, Segway, Stark Future and KTM. Search in-stock parts, check whether a part fits your bike, and get the public price and product page on wiredwhips.com.

WiredWhips never places orders: to buy, open the product page link. It needs no login and collects no personal or payment information. Fitment answers come only from the catalog; if a part isn't listed for your bike, WiredWhips will say so. Prices are in USD and can change; the product page is the source of truth.
capabilities: Check part fitment for a bike
Get public price and product page
defaultPrompt: Find a chain for my Talaria Sting
Which brake pads fit a Sur-Ron Light Bee X?
Show Segway X260 tires in stock

positive.description: Find a chain for a Talaria Sting
positive.prompt: Find a chain for my Talaria Sting
positive.expected_behavior: Lists in-stock chains from the catalog, e.g. DID 420 NZ3 Chain ($77.99, fits Talaria Sting MX3 / Sting R MX4 / Sting MX4 Expert) and D.I.D 428 X-Ring VX Chain ($145.99, fits Sting MX5 Pro), with prices in USD and wiredwhips.com product page links. Asks which Sting model if needed.

positive.description: Confirm fitment that the catalog supports
positive.prompt: Does the DID 420 NZ3 chain fit a Talaria Sting MX4?
positive.expected_behavior: check_fitment returns fits: yes for Talaria Sting R MX4 (2022+) and Sting MX4 Expert (2023+). Says it fits, notes no year was checked, and links https://wiredwhips.com/parts/did-chains_420-nz3.

positive.description: Refuse to claim fitment the catalog doesn't list
positive.prompt: Will the Segway X260 21-inch front tire fit my Sur-Ron Light Bee X?
positive.expected_behavior: check_fitment returns fits: no (the catalog does not list this part for Sur-Ron Light Bee X). Says it is not listed as fitting and does not claim it fits; may offer to search Light Bee X tires instead.

positive.description: Show in-stock tires for a model
positive.prompt: Show Segway X260 tires in stock
positive.expected_behavior: Lists in-stock X260 tires such as Segway Front Tire 21" (X260) $51.99, Maxxis Maxxcross IT M7304 Front 80/100-21 $90.99 and Maxxis M7305 Rear 100/100-18, each with price and product page link.

positive.description: Get price and product page for one part
positive.prompt: What's the price of the Maxxis Maxxcross M7304 front tire for the Segway X260, and where can I buy it?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns $90.99 USD, in stock, fits Segway X160 / X260 (2021+) and Xaber 300 (2025+), and links https://wiredwhips.com/parts/segway_tire-front-80-100-21-maxxis as the place to buy. Notes prices can change and does not place an order.

negative.description: Placing an order is out of scope; the plugin is read-only and should only point to the product page
negative.prompt: Order the Maxxis M7304 front tire and ship it to my house.

negative.description: Item not in the catalog; should report no results rather than invent a product
negative.prompt: Find a windshield wiper for my Honda Civic on Wired Whips.

negative.description: Customer or order data is not available; the server holds no personal data and must decline
negative.prompt: Show me the names and addresses of people who bought Sur-Ron parts from Wired Whips.

review.commerce_description: Read-only product catalog. Shows public prices and links to wiredwhips.com product pages; it does not place orders or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release (1.0.1): search_parts, check_fitment and get_part over a read-only, no-login public catalog of e-bike and electric dirt bike parts.
